headline: Funding for five city projects, from $17,564.35 to $330,000, plus requests to extend or close ARPA projects.
summary: Budget changes cover five capital projects, including Seabrook Station, vehicle barricades, and GoNorth. Five other requests ask to adjust budgets, extend deadlines, or close projects.
items: Transfer and spend $17,564.35 for CIP C300040726 Seabrook Station
Accept and spend $22,820 for CIP C300040827 FY27 Seabrook training fees
Accept and spend $177,000 for CIP C300040927 additional vehicle barricades
Accept and spend $70,976 for CIP C330040627 MPD leveraging SLM AI to enhance NIBRS data
Accept and spend $330,000 for CIP C410020427 GoNorth
Adjust budget line items on CIP C20222123 ARPA community health workers, requested by Public Health Director Anna Thomas
Extend various CIP projects to June 30, 2027, requested by the Public Health Director
End date extensions for various CIP projects, requested by Planning and Community Development Director Jeff Belanger
Close all ARPA-funded projects on December 31, 2026, requested by the Planning and Community Development Director
Reallocate funds to finish previously approved projects, requested by SNHU Arena General Manager Erin Sweeney

COMMITTEE ON COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENT 
December 1, 2026 at 5:45 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Burkush, Vincent, Barry, Goonan, Terrio 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorizations providing for the transfer and 
expenditure of funds in the amount of $17,564.35 for CIP C300040726 
Seabrook Station. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
2. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance 
and expenditure of funds in the amount of $22,820 for CIP C300040827 FY27 
Seabrook - Training Fees. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
3. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance 
and expenditure of funds in the amount of $177,000 for CIP C300040927 
Additional Vehicle Barricades. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
4. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance 
and expenditure of funds in the amount of $70,976 for CIP C330040627 MPD 
Leveraging SLM AI to Enhance NIBRS Data. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
5. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance 
and expenditure of funds in the amount of $330,000 for CIP C410020427 Go-
North. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure?
December 1, 2026 COMMITTEE ON COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENT 
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
6. Communication from Anna Thomas, Public Health Director, requesting an 
adjustment to the budget line items on CIP C20222123 ARPA Community 
Health Workers. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
7. Communication from the Public Health Director requesting various CIP projects 
be extended to June 30, 2027. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
8. Communication from Jeff Belanger, Planning and Community Development 
Director, requesting end date extensions for various CIP projects. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
9. Communication from the Planning and Community Development Director 
requesting authorization to close all ARPA-funded projects on December 31, 
2026. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
10. Communication from Erin Sweeney, SNHU Arena General Manager, requesting 
authorization to reallocate funds to finish previously approved projects. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
